decisions.why: Unresolved PI identity: the original complete source has only J. Wang at this authorship under a provider ID displayed as H. Wang. An exact-ID scan of674whole works includes three full Hui Wang bylines and no full Jianyong Wang. The computing PI has separately owned Jianyong Wang/王建勇 self-identification and PID24/2006. Abbreviated byline, shared institution and dynamically adviser-anchored provider ID do not independently establish that this authorship is the computing PI. Hold this exact PI/source claim pending primary byline/person evidence; do not reject the scientific paper, globally assign/reject its author ID, or change other PIs.
